unique_math_solution: The source pieces are straight 1-by-k bars for k=1,2,3,4,5. B has no horizontal or vertical run of five cells, so it cannot contain the five-bar. A, C, D and E each have an exact bar tiling; the attached exhaustive finite cell search saves one complete placement of each size in each feasible board and proves B infeasible. For D, place the five-bar vertically in its left column; put lengths 3 and 2 in the second column and lengths 4 and 1 in the third column. Thus the red horizontal placement is an optional failed placement, not a physical requirement. Only B is impossible. The options lack letters in the frozen PNG; A through E follow the original left-to-right five-choice order, which is preserved and disclosed.
